newsitem.title: JAPAN: INPEX, Total to invest $50 mln in Kalimantan oil.
newsitem.headline: INPEX, Total to invest $50 mln in Kalimantan oil.

text.p: Japan's Indonesia Petroleum Ltd (INPEX) said on Wednesday it along with French energy group Total SA would invest a combined $50 million to explore two offshore oil blocks in Indonesia.
INPEX will explore the Sebawang 1 and Saliki blocks offshore East Kalimantan with French energy group Total SA, which is the main operator of the project.
The two companies signed a production sharing agreement last Thursday with Indonesia's state oil company Pertamina.
INPEX, established in 1966 with the aim of exploring oil fields, produces crude oil, propane and condensate mainly in Indonesia.

Earlier this month, INPEX signed a separate production sharing agreement with Pertamina to explore the Rabe block, offshore East Timor. INPEX said its investment in the Rabe block would amount to an estimated $96 million.
